summary: New root ṭwr not in the glossary
after: Stem II (mṭawarle [erschlossen; belegt mṭawarlox]/mṭawər): 1: entwickeln, verbessern; (mit ruḥo) sich entwickeln, sich verbessern; 1 (detransitive): (Detrans.) sich entwickeln; entwickelt, fortgeschritten sein

new_senses.gloss: entwickeln, verbessern; (mit ruḥo) sich entwickeln, sich verbessern
new_senses.rationale: Repeated stem-II forms take language, human objects or ruḥo. The contrast of language improvement, developing people and self-improvement is compositional, not several independent meanings.
miṭawər predicates development of work without an agent; feminine mṭawarto predicates an advanced country. These support an event/state pairing, though the adjective may also be borrowed.

added_examples.turoyo: Ǧan: bəṯər me Mor Barṣawmo ayko azzox w mṭawarlox u lišonayḏox?
added_examples.translation: Jan: After Mor Barsawmo, where did you go and develop your language?
added_examples.rationale: Only attested active Preterit, with 2sg.m -lox and an explicit language object; the 3sg base form is reconstructed and marked.

added_examples.turoyo: <...> Dawle xəd u Swed, b briṯo – bu šəwolo dan niše – kməḥšowo dawle mṭawarto.
added_examples.translation: <...> A country like Sweden is considered an advanced country in the world with regard to the question of women.
added_examples.rationale: New Detransitive Part. Pass./1: feminine agreement with dawle; borrowed-adjective status remains a question.

added_examples.translation: The important thing is for the reader to express his opinion. As I said, opinion always develops us. It develops us so that we become still better,
